rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,500 cash deficit by scaling contiguous land to 28-32 plots synchronized with 10-11 hands and extending the land expansion freeze to Day 15, fully utilizing workforce capacity to capture compounding Strawberry flushes. It implements dynamic midday liquidation (>=0.78x base floor when shed fullness >=40% or surplus >=12) with terminal shed clearance advanced to step 696, while dynamically allocating 3-4 plots for >=2.2x Carrot shop contracts and activating a hyper-fertilized Carrot backfill on open plots between Days 22-26. Furthermore, it overhauls farm micro-dispatch with pre-harvest well refills for zero-delay in-situ watering and backpack-gated shed drop-offs (>=75% capacity) to maintain fluid shed stock for continuous arbitrage.
